notes.text: The page starts by pairing Y-prime with E and expressing Y-prime(I) and Y-prime(J) as contracted products. It says the isomorphismes (11) amount to the next pair of isomorphisms, then describes these through isomorphisms of right pi-one sets. These are accounts of what the source states; no equivalence has been independently proved in this reading pass.

The source then says those data amount to hom maps from B-gamma to automorphisms/bijections, compatible with the pi-one actions on the left and right. The first Aut lower index is crossed out, and a short detached stroke above its A remains unexplained. The map connector itself is locally doubtful. The uncertainty is visual, and no expected mathematical construction was used to add an arrowhead or define an accented operator.

The following paragraph starts Or la donnée de ces applications and uses équivaut. A phrase tentatively read peut se is crossed out; une is crossed out in d'une applications. The pair of lower maps has the union of the B-gamma as source and the two underlying-set automorphism groups as targets. Both lower arrows have heads, including the small head mainly above the lower shaft.

The final sentence is retained with the author's singular wording celle qu'on cherche est and the later plural celles déjà envisagées. It describes an opération déduite par the operations already considered. The wording is not grammatically regularized. The last punctuation consists of four dots.

Both page numbers are transcribed: 7 at the upper right and 13 in graphite at the bottom left. Their relationship or authorship is not established by this one-page reading. The lower group glyph does not settle the shared calligraphic-E/Sigma uncertainty.

Main adjudication prefers a bare shaft at the first map, where the right end is blunt, but retains uncertainty because the upper-only arrowhead habit also occurs on this sheet. The two lower map heads are clear. No date is written on the page.

All six equation rows, ten low wedge indices, twelve pi-one graphs, eighteen covered X graphs, the brace structures, three B-gamma map connectors, cancellation states, prose, four original MARKS, and both pencil numerals were checked. Glyph/encoding confirmations are not new material rows.

The accepted singular celle qu'on cherche est, later plural celles, short iso. and hom, point-free ens and op, extra parentheses in the second J equation, and four final points are retained as written. The manuscript wording is not normalized.

Insertion-guide check: no live interlinear insertion accompanied by a separate guide or caret was identified in the completed original/half views. The detached stroke above the first Aut is already represented by its accent/capital-formation alternative, and the strokes below it belong to the cancelled index. No guide was omitted by an inserted wrapper on this page.
